units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 39a:2">Ab. Zar. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>מפני שעֵרְבוֹנָהּ עולה עמה</he> (Rashi to 35ᵇ a. v. <he>והחילק</he>: <he>שעירבונה</he>) because its following goes with it (borrowed fr.
Ex. XII, 38), i.e. because all the small fish resembling the ḥilleḳ are packed with it when offered for sale.
